# Repository setup checklist

Apply these settings in GitHub to make the repo discoverable:

## Topics

Add these topics under **About → Topics**:

```
ai-agents, multi-agent, provenance, audit-trail, git-native, merkle-tree, sha256, ai-generated-artifacts, agent-coordination, tamper-evident
```

## Description

Suggested one-line description:

> Git-native multi-agent provenance framework. Verifiable AI-agent collaboration using Git, SHA-256 packets, and Merkle-tree manifests.

## Website / homepage

Optional: link to the repo itself or a future docs site.

```
https://github.com/dbottrader/Holbrook-CP8-HHC
```

## Releases

After merging this branch, tag `v0.1.0` and create a release titled:

> Holbrook CP8 v0.1.0 — Git-native provenance for AI-agent collaboration

Include the 30-second demo commands in the release notes.
